claims.quote: It is native to Southeast Asia, specifically the Shan State in Myanmar, and was first discovered in 2006 by a German aquarist named Tanja Schwedt.
The celestial pearl danio, Danio margaritatus, is a miniature cyprinid from the Salween drainage in Shan State, eastern Myanmar.
It's since been found in waters associated with the Salween (aka Thanlwin) River throughout southern Shan and even across the border in northern Thailand.
